description: This file contains CUDA-specific implementations of linear algebra functions for PyTorch's ATen library. It defines template specializations and functions interfacing with cuSOLVER and cuBLAS to perform matrix factorizations, eigenvalue computations, and related linear algebra operations on GPU tensors. The code handles various data types, including float, double, and complex types, and provides buffer size estimation and execution functions. It also supports batched and strided batched operations, with conditional implementations for different CUDA versions.

methods.description: Performs batched eigenvalue decomposition for float data type using cuSOLVER's Xsyev interface.
